title: Don't Let Me Get On The Train

lines.text: Don't let me get on the train.
[quiet, determined] Six days left. He told me not to fall for him... so I went looking for him.
[softly] Same corner. Six-forty. And there he was.
lines.show: Same corner. 6:40. And there he was.

lines.text: [surprised, a warm smile] You again. The girl who almost got hit by a car.
[quietly] He remembered the car. But not a single message.
[a little shy] I'm Kabir, by the way. Coffee? You look like you need one.
[warm, smiling] We talked until they closed the café. He laughed like he'd known me forever.
[softer] Then I noticed his watch. Still stopped at eleven eleven.
lines.show: Then I noticed his watch. Still stopped at 11:11.

lines.text: [quiet, a little sad] It stopped the night my brother died. I never fixed it.
[low, uneasy] That night, at eleven eleven... my phone lit up.
lines.show: That night, at 11:11… my phone lit up.

lines.text: [tense, low] Mira. You found me, didn't you? Listen. Tomorrow... don't let me get on the train.
[confused, quiet] Don't let him get on the train?
[almost a whisper] If I get on that train... you're the one who doesn't come home.
